info.biography: 袁术之女，史称有节行。袁术败亡以后依附袁术旧部刘勋，跟随刘勋投降孙策，后来入孙权后宫。皇后潘淑性格擅妒，袁姬曾多次遭其诋毁。

authorityBoundary: Current hero, official release and direct client text agree. The OL大乔 repost is a same-product player guide, not an exclusive official FAQ. Unsettled allocator, mark residency, source-loss and native-boundary combinations are identified as implementation inferences.

ruleInterpretation.basis: Current text; native completed atomic movement interpretation
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Capture one actual committed movement batch, separately for each living source owner that loses exactly two distinct original Hand primary entities. Hand1 plus Equipment1, two separate Hand1 batches, Processing cleanup and WoodenOx grain spill do not qualify. Destinations need not be discard: real use payment, gift and Hand-to-deck return are eligible. Additional non-Hand primary entities do not change the Hand cardinality. Source bindings are frozen at the actual completion, not reconstructed from a later invented CardsMoved event.

ruleInterpretation.basis: Current text and same-product guide; end allocation/order is implementation inference, not dedicated FAQ
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Freeze YuanJi as first recipient at the actual top and the original losing player as second recipient at the actual bottom. Execute two independent native Draw1 calls and show the actual obtained entities. When both references are the same person, execute both calls. Finish the first draw native movement/HP/SkillsChanged/Dying children before the second call. Each call may reshuffle independently. Only two actually obtained shown cards can compare suits; exhaustion invents neither a card nor suit. A mismatch suppresses Jieyan for this owner until the actual-turn cursor changes, including source loss/regrant and same-round extra-turn distinctions.

ruleInterpretation.basis: Current text, client card tags and guide; exact project boundary and residency are implementation inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: A genuine RoundStarting issues one native Draw2 and marks precisely its actual original entities; an exhausted request may complete with zero in its own receipt and does not broaden generic zero-draw invoices. The existing own TurnStartBeforeNormalFlow boundary is the project turn-start return. Return all outstanding Jinghua cards still in the original owner Hand in one native atomic batch to the bottom, with privately chosen bottom-first order. Extra turns have their own turn-start boundary but never repeat a same-round issuance.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Shuiyue actual turn and old round end
ruleInterpretation.basis: Current text; full native actual-turn and old-round composition is implementation inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Use the real own AfterTurnEnded mother, not Ending phase or next RoundStarting, for native Draw2. A real RoundEndingBoundary keeps the old actual turn while returns and children drain, then emits RoundEnded before ActualTurnCursorReturned and the next RoundStarted. All pending live extra turns and old-round native children finish first. Return every currently held original Shuiyue entity in one whole Hand-to-deck batch per owner/skill, with privately selected top-first order. Four marked cards from two actual turns are one Hand4 loss, not two false Hand2 invocations. Different owners remain distinct native resolutions. A new extra turn declared by a closing child follows the latest native pending declaration; the old round still closes only once, and the next normal turn advances its number. This closing-child ordering is an explicit project inference.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Original mark lifetime and source loss
ruleInterpretation.basis: Current text and client identity tags; unresolved lifetime details are explicit implementation inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Track the actual original draw source/hash and entity, not names or a public fake pile. Using or gifting a marked entity is ordinary native card movement. The mark belongs only to its original owner; a foreign holder inherits no mark. The same entity returning to that owner Hand before its next applicable boundary remains eligible. At the boundary all captured outstanding claims expire; foreign-held cards are left in place and cannot be reclaimed globally. Existing return rights survive loss/regrant of the issuing skill. A dead participant receives no newly issued draw, while already paid native children finish exactly once.

Only Jieyan performs public CardsRevealed. Jinghua/Shuiyue draws and return ordering use prepared per-viewer snapshots; mark labels appear only where the original Hand entity is visible. Resolution progress is owned by the original ProgramSkillFrame with defensively frozen lists. New fact payloads are scalar; the existing public reveal collection uses existing commit projection. Source-loss/death children, reshuffle and whole-return atomic effects resume without a second payment.
